-- =============================================================================
-- CONSOLIDATED BIGQUERY SQL: CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC
-- Final Consumer: CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC
-- Generated by: BigQuery SQL Consolidation Agent
-- Runtime Parameters:
--   @ip_version       STRING  -- BW version filter applied to bic_zio_ver
--   @ip_week_ly       STRING  -- Last-year week filter applied to bic_zio_sweek
--   @ip_week_cy       STRING  -- Current-year week; used for retail calendar join,
--                             --   comp-flag filter, CAL_WEEK, and CAL_WEEK_NUMBER
--   @ip_version_comp_flag  STRING  -- Comp-flag version filter applied to comp_ver
--   @v_week           STRING  -- Prior fiscal week (replaces SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK());
--                             --   used as the procedure-level filter on zweek when
--                             --   populating the comp-flag staging data
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05
-- Logic: Reads weekly financial actuals from the physical BQ table
--        v_bic_azsrp_ds212 (HANA: AZSRP_DS072_VT_S4). Applies client
--        filter (mandt IN ('110','200')), fiscal variant filter
--        (fiscvarnt = 'K4'), version filter (@ip_version), last-year
--        week filter (@ip_week_ly), and audit-trail filter
--        (bic_zio_saudt IN ('1','10')). Aggregates all measures by SUM
--        over all non-measure dimensions, preserving the CUBE
--        aggregation semantics of CV_BASE_FIN_WEEKLY_ACTUAL_S4.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds212
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200'), fiscvarnt = 'K4',
--          bic_zio_ver = @ip_version, bic_zio_sweek = @ip_week_ly,
--          bic_zio_saudt IN ('1','10')
-- Aggregation: SUM(b631_s_amount), SUM(bic_zio_d1amt..d7amt)
--              grouped by all non-measure columns
-- =====================================================================
WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    mandt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    currency,
    b631_s_ledger,
    recordmode,
    SUM(b631_s_amount)   AS b631_s_amount,
    SUM(bic_zio_d1amt)   AS bic_zio_d1amt,
    SUM(bic_zio_d2amt)   AS bic_zio_d2amt,
    SUM(bic_zio_d3amt)   AS bic_zio_d3amt,
    SUM(bic_zio_d4amt)   AS bic_zio_d4amt,
    SUM(bic_zio_d5amt)   AS bic_zio_d5amt,
    SUM(bic_zio_d6amt)   AS bic_zio_d6amt,
    SUM(bic_zio_d7amt)   AS bic_zio_d7amt
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_bic_azsrp_ds212`
  WHERE
    mandt      IN ('110', '200')
    AND fiscvarnt  = 'K4'
    AND bic_zio_ver   = @ip_version
    AND bic_zio_sweek = @ip_week_ly
    AND bic_zio_saudt IN ('1', '10')
  GROUP BY
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    mandt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    currency,
    b631_s_ledger,
    recordmode
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: PC_HIER
-- Logic: Reads profit-center hierarchy nodes from v_hrrp_node
--        (HANA: HRRP_NODE). Filters for client ('120','200'),
--        parent nodes containing 'CORE_RET', and valid-to date
--        = DATE '9999-12-31' (current/active nodes only).
--        Corresponds to PC_HEIR.CV_BASE_MD_HRRP_NODE_S4 usage in
--        CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200'), parnode LIKE '%CORE_RET%',
--          hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
-- =====================================================================
PC_HIER AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    nodevalue
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE
    mandt     IN ('120', '200')
    AND parnode   LIKE '%CORE_RET%'
    AND hryvalto  = DATE '9999-12-31'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: Join_WeeklySnapshot_PC_Hier
-- Logic: Inner-joins weekly actuals with profit-center hierarchy to
--        restrict actuals to stores in the CORE_RET hierarchy.
--        Join key: b631_s_proftctr = nodevalue AND mandt = mandt.
-- Source: WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05, PC_HIER
-- Join: INNER JOIN PC_HIER ON ws.b631_s_proftctr = ph.nodevalue
--       AND ws.mandt = ph.mandt
-- =====================================================================
Join_WeeklySnapshot_PC_Hier AS (
  SELECT
    ws.fiscper,
    ws.fiscvarnt,
    ws.fiscyear,
    ws.fiscper3,
    ws.mandt,
    ws.bic_zio_sweek,
    ws.b631_s_chrtacct,
    ws.b631_s_co_area,
    ws.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    ws.b631_s_proftctr,
    ws.b631_s_costcntr,
    ws.b631_s_funcarea,
    ws.bic_zio_ver,
    ws.bic_zio_saudt,
    ws.b631_s_gl_acct,
    ws.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    ws.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    ws.currency,
    ws.b631_s_ledger,
    ws.recordmode,
    ws.b631_s_amount,
    ws.bic_zio_d1amt,
    ws.bic_zio_d2amt,
    ws.bic_zio_d3amt,
    ws.bic_zio_d4amt,
    ws.bic_zio_d5amt,
    ws.bic_zio_d6amt,
    ws.bic_zio_d7amt
  FROM
    WEEKLY_SNAPSHOT_DS05 ws
    INNER JOIN PC_HIER ph
      ON  ws.b631_s_proftctr = ph.nodevalue
      AND ws.mandt            = ph.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: GL_HIER
-- Logic: Reads G/L account hierarchy nodes from v_hrrp_node
--        (HANA: HRRP_NODE). Filters for client ('120','200'),
--        parent nodes ending in '181', valid-to = DATE '9999-12-31',
--        and hierarchy ID = 'CVS2'. Computes cal_node_value as
--        LTRIM(nodevalue,'0') for downstream join.
--        Corresponds to GL_HEIR.CV_BASE_MD_HRRP_NODE_S4 usage in
--        CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200'), parnode LIKE '%181',
--          hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31', hryid = 'CVS2'
-- Calculation: LTRIM(nodevalue,'0') AS cal_node_value
-- =====================================================================
GL_HIER AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    nodevalue,
    hryid,
    LTRIM(nodevalue, '0') AS cal_node_value
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE
    mandt    IN ('120', '200')
    AND parnode  LIKE '%181'
    AND hryvalto = DATE '9999-12-31'
    AND hryid    = 'CVS2'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: Join_GL_Hier
-- Logic: Inner-joins the PC-hierarchy-filtered actuals with the G/L
--        account hierarchy to restrict actuals to accounts in the
--        CVS2 / 181 hierarchy. Join key:
--        b631_s_gl_acct = nodevalue AND mandt = mandt.
-- Source: Join_WeeklySnapshot_PC_Hier, GL_HIER
-- Join: INNER JOIN GL_HIER ON j.b631_s_gl_acct = gh.nodevalue
--       AND j.mandt = gh.mandt
-- =====================================================================
Join_GL_Hier AS (
  SELECT
    j.fiscper,
    j.fiscvarnt,
    j.fiscyear,
    j.fiscper3,
    j.mandt,
    j.bic_zio_sweek,
    j.b631_s_chrtacct,
    j.b631_s_co_area,
    j.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j.b631_s_proftctr,
    j.b631_s_costcntr,
    j.b631_s_funcarea,
    j.bic_zio_ver,
    j.bic_zio_saudt,
    j.b631_s_gl_acct,
    j.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    j.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    j.currency,
    j.b631_s_ledger,
    j.recordmode,
    j.b631_s_amount,
    j.bic_zio_d1amt,
    j.bic_zio_d2amt,
    j.bic_zio_d3amt,
    j.bic_zio_d4amt,
    j.bic_zio_d5amt,
    j.bic_zio_d6amt,
    j.bic_zio_d7amt,
    @ip_week_cy AS cal_week
  FROM
    Join_WeeklySnapshot_PC_Hier j
    INNER JOIN GL_HIER gh
      ON  j.b631_s_gl_acct = gh.nodevalue
      AND j.mandt           = gh.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL
-- Logic: Provides store profile attributes by inlining the logic of
--        CV_COMP_MD_SRPACT_STATIC, which reads from the staging table
--        TBL_WSS_SRP_ATTR_ACT. That staging table is populated by
--        STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES, which inserts all rows from
--        CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4 (= v_ztsrp_attr_act filtered by
--        mandt IN ('120','200')) without any additional filter.
--        CV_COMP_MD_SRPACT_STATIC is a CUBE/Aggregation view that
--        SUMs the measure columns; all non-measure columns are grouped.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')  [from CV_BASE_MD_SRPACT_S4]
-- Aggregation: SUM(rx_hrs_oper), SUM(fs_hrs_oper),
--              SUM(retail_sqft_amt), SUM(total_sqft_amt)
--              grouped by all non-measure columns
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    kokrs,
    kostl,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_close_dat,
    fs_open_dat,
    fs_close_dat,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    address,
    city,
    state,
    zipcode,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    division_mgr,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    area_mgr,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    region_mgr,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zone_code,
    district_mgr,
    zone_desc,
    major_region_code,
    major_region,
    store_type,
    store_type_desc,
    rx_store_desc,
    distribution_cntr,
    distribution_cntr_desc,
    store_24_hr,
    budget_open_dat,
    budget_closed_dat,
    budget_reloc_dat,
    const_open_dat,
    const_close_dat,
    const_relo_dat,
    relocation_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    budget_emerg_mkt_ind,
    company_code,
    company_code_desc,
    original_fs_open_dat,
    original_rx_open_dat,
    group_one,
    group_two,
    ard_sort_key,
    area_cost_center,
    regiion_cost_center,
    county_code,
    county_desc,
    sqft_bracket_desc,
    sqft_sort_key,
    acquisition_code,
    acquisition_desc,
    photo_lab_add_dat,
    photo_lab_close_dat,
    min_hrs_ind,
    createdby,
    created_on,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    SUM(rx_hrs_oper)      AS rx_hrs_oper,
    SUM(fs_hrs_oper)      AS fs_hrs_oper,
    SUM(rx_store)         AS rx_store,
    SUM(retail_sqft_amt)  AS retail_sqft_amt,
    SUM(total_sqft_amt)   AS total_sqft_amt
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
  GROUP BY
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    kokrs,
    kostl,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_close_dat,
    fs_open_dat,
    fs_close_dat,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    address,
    city,
    state,
    zipcode,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    division_mgr,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    area_mgr,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    region_mgr,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zone_code,
    district_mgr,
    zone_desc,
    major_region_code,
    major_region,
    store_type,
    store_type_desc,
    rx_store_desc,
    distribution_cntr,
    distribution_cntr_desc,
    store_24_hr,
    budget_open_dat,
    budget_closed_dat,
    budget_reloc_dat,
    const_open_dat,
    const_close_dat,
    const_relo_dat,
    relocation_dat,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    budget_emerg_mkt_ind,
    company_code,
    company_code_desc,
    original_fs_open_dat,
    original_rx_open_dat,
    group_one,
    group_two,
    ard_sort_key,
    area_cost_center,
    regiion_cost_center,
    county_code,
    county_desc,
    sqft_bracket_desc,
    sqft_sort_key,
    acquisition_code,
    acquisition_desc,
    photo_lab_add_dat,
    photo_lab_close_dat,
    min_hrs_ind,
    createdby,
    created_on,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: Join_Projection_StoreAttr
-- Logic: Left-joins GL-hierarchy-filtered actuals with store profile
--        attributes. Adds store geography, hierarchy, and date
--        attributes. Join key: b631_s_proftctr = prctr AND mandt = mandt.
-- Source: Join_GL_Hier, STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL
-- Join: LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL ON p.b631_s_proftctr = sa.prctr
--       AND p.mandt = sa.mandt
-- =====================================================================
Join_Projection_StoreAttr AS (
  SELECT
    p.fiscper,
    p.fiscvarnt,
    p.fiscyear,
    p.fiscper3,
    p.mandt,
    p.bic_zio_sweek,
    p.b631_s_chrtacct,
    p.b631_s_co_area,
    p.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    p.b631_s_proftctr,
    p.b631_s_costcntr,
    p.b631_s_funcarea,
    p.bic_zio_ver,
    p.bic_zio_saudt,
    p.b631_s_gl_acct,
    p.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    p.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    p.currency,
    p.b631_s_ledger,
    p.recordmode,
    p.b631_s_amount,
    p.bic_zio_d1amt,
    p.bic_zio_d2amt,
    p.bic_zio_d3amt,
    p.bic_zio_d4amt,
    p.bic_zio_d5amt,
    p.bic_zio_d6amt,
    p.bic_zio_d7amt,
    p.cal_week,
    sa.strnum,
    sa.rep_mkt_code,
    sa.rep_mkt_desc,
    sa.emerg_mkt_ind,
    sa.division_code,
    sa.division_desc,
    sa.area_code,
    sa.area_desc,
    sa.region_code,
    sa.region_desc,
    sa.district_code,
    sa.district_desc,
    sa.city,
    sa.state,
    sa.fs_open_dat,
    sa.rx_open_dat,
    sa.rx_division_code,
    sa.rx_area_code,
    sa.rx_region_code,
    sa.rx_district_code
  FROM
    Join_GL_Hier p
    LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR_ACTUAL sa
      ON  p.b631_s_proftctr = sa.prctr
      AND p.mandt            = sa.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: RETAIL_CAL
-- Logic: Reads retail calendar week data from v_ztfigl_rcalweek
--        (HANA: ZTFIGL_RCALWEEK). Filters for client rclnt IN
--        ('120','200'). Corresponds to CV_BASE_MD_RCALWEEK_S4.
--        Provides week start/end dates for the current-year week join.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
RETAIL_CAL AS (
  SELECT
    rclnt,
    zzweek,
    zcalyrp,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    zryrqtr,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE
    rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: Join_RetailCal
-- Logic: Left-joins store-attribute-enriched actuals with the retail
--        calendar to add week start and end dates. Join key:
--        cal_week = zzweek AND mandt = rclnt (both STRING).
-- Source: Join_Projection_StoreAttr, RETAIL_CAL
-- Join: LEFT JOIN RETAIL_CAL ON j.cal_week = rc.zzweek
--       AND j.mandt = rc.rclnt
-- =====================================================================
Join_RetailCal AS (
  SELECT
    j.fiscper,
    j.fiscvarnt,
    j.fiscyear,
    j.fiscper3,
    j.mandt,
    j.bic_zio_sweek,
    j.b631_s_chrtacct,
    j.b631_s_co_area,
    j.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    j.b631_s_proftctr,
    j.b631_s_costcntr,
    j.b631_s_funcarea,
    j.bic_zio_ver,
    j.bic_zio_saudt,
    j.b631_s_gl_acct,
    j.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    j.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    j.currency,
    j.b631_s_ledger,
    j.recordmode,
    j.b631_s_amount,
    j.bic_zio_d1amt,
    j.bic_zio_d2amt,
    j.bic_zio_d3amt,
    j.bic_zio_d4amt,
    j.bic_zio_d5amt,
    j.bic_zio_d6amt,
    j.bic_zio_d7amt,
    j.cal_week,
    j.strnum,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code,
    rc.zrwstrtdate,
    rc.zrwenddate
  FROM
    Join_Projection_StoreAttr j
    LEFT JOIN RETAIL_CAL rc
      ON  j.cal_week = rc.zzweek
      AND j.mandt    = rc.rclnt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: COMP_FLAG_LY
-- Logic: Provides comparison-flag data by inlining the logic of
--        CV_COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC, which reads from the staging table
--        TBL_WSS_SRP_COMPFLAG. That staging table is populated by
--        STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES, which inserts from CV_BASE_MD_COMPFL_S4
--        (= v_ztsrp_compfl filtered by mandt IN ('110','200')) with the
--        additional procedure-level filter zweek = @v_week (prior fiscal
--        week from SFN_PRIOR_FISCAL_WEEK()). CV_COMP_MD_COMPFL_STATIC
--        is a DIMENSION/Projection view (row-level, no aggregation).
--        The final consumer further filters by zweek = @ip_week_cy and
--        comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag.
--        Both the procedure filter (zweek = @v_week) and the consumer
--        filter (zweek = @ip_week_cy) are preserved at their respective
--        logical stages.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: mandt IN ('110','200')  [from CV_BASE_MD_COMPFL_S4]
--          zweek = @v_week          [from STP_WSS_SRP_ATTRIBUTES procedure]
--          zweek = @ip_week_cy      [from CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC consumer]
--          comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag  [from consumer]
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG_LY AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    strnum,
    comp_ver,
    zweek,
    zmonth,
    zyear,
    fs_comp_pre,
    rx_comp_pre,
    fs_comp_mon,
    rx_comp_mon,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE
    mandt    IN ('110', '200')
    AND zweek    = @v_week
    AND zweek    = @ip_week_cy
    AND comp_ver = @ip_version_comp_flag
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 11: Join_CompFlag
-- Logic: Left-joins retail-calendar-enriched actuals with the
--        comparison-flag data. Join key:
--        b631_s_proftctr = prctr AND mandt = mandt.
-- Source: Join_RetailCal, COMP_FLAG_LY
-- Join: LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_LY ON wn.b631_s_proftctr = cfl.prctr
--       AND wn.mandt = cfl.mandt
-- =====================================================================
Join_CompFlag AS (
  SELECT
    wn.fiscper,
    wn.fiscvarnt,
    wn.fiscyear,
    wn.fiscper3,
    wn.mandt,
    wn.bic_zio_sweek,
    wn.b631_s_chrtacct,
    wn.b631_s_co_area,
    wn.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    wn.b631_s_proftctr,
    wn.b631_s_costcntr,
    wn.b631_s_funcarea,
    wn.bic_zio_ver,
    wn.bic_zio_saudt,
    wn.b631_s_gl_acct,
    wn.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    wn.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    wn.currency,
    wn.b631_s_ledger,
    wn.recordmode,
    wn.b631_s_amount,
    wn.bic_zio_d1amt,
    wn.bic_zio_d2amt,
    wn.bic_zio_d3amt,
    wn.bic_zio_d4amt,
    wn.bic_zio_d5amt,
    wn.bic_zio_d6amt,
    wn.bic_zio_d7amt,
    wn.cal_week,
    wn.strnum,
    wn.rep_mkt_code,
    wn.rep_mkt_desc,
    wn.emerg_mkt_ind,
    wn.division_code,
    wn.division_desc,
    wn.area_code,
    wn.area_desc,
    wn.region_code,
    wn.region_desc,
    wn.district_code,
    wn.district_desc,
    wn.city,
    wn.state,
    wn.fs_open_dat,
    wn.rx_open_dat,
    wn.rx_division_code,
    wn.rx_area_code,
    wn.rx_region_code,
    wn.rx_district_code,
    wn.zrwstrtdate,
    wn.zrwenddate,
    cfl.zweek      AS zweek,
    cfl.zmonth     AS zmonth,
    cfl.zyear      AS zyear,
    cfl.comp_ver   AS comp_ver,
    cfl.fs_comp_wk,
    cfl.rx_comp_wk
  FROM
    Join_RetailCal wn
    LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG_LY cfl
      ON  wn.b631_s_proftctr = cfl.prctr
      AND wn.mandt            = cfl.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 12: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Reads profit-center text from v_cepct (HANA: CEPCT).
--        Filters for client mandt IN ('120','200'). Provides ltext
--        (long text) as profit_center_text for the final join.
--        Corresponds to CV_BASE_MD_CEPCT_S4 usage.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- Filters: mandt IN ('120','200')
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    spras,
    datbi,
    kokrs,
    ktext,
    ltext,
    mctxt
  FROM
    `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
  WHERE
    mandt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 13: Join_ProfitCenterText
-- Logic: Left-joins comp-flag-enriched actuals with profit-center text
--        to add the profit center long description. Join key:
--        b631_s_proftctr = prctr AND mandt = mandt.
-- Source: Join_CompFlag, PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Join: LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT ON jcf.b631_s_proftctr = pct.prctr
--       AND jcf.mandt = pct.mandt
-- =====================================================================
Join_ProfitCenterText AS (
  SELECT
    jcf.fiscper,
    jcf.fiscvarnt,
    jcf.fiscyear,
    jcf.fiscper3,
    jcf.mandt,
    jcf.bic_zio_sweek,
    jcf.b631_s_chrtacct,
    jcf.b631_s_co_area,
    jcf.bic_zio_cmpcd,
    jcf.b631_s_proftctr,
    jcf.b631_s_costcntr,
    jcf.b631_s_funcarea,
    jcf.bic_zio_ver,
    jcf.bic_zio_saudt,
    jcf.b631_s_gl_acct,
    jcf.bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    jcf.bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    jcf.currency,
    jcf.b631_s_ledger,
    jcf.recordmode,
    jcf.b631_s_amount,
    jcf.bic_zio_d1amt,
    jcf.bic_zio_d2amt,
    jcf.bic_zio_d3amt,
    jcf.bic_zio_d4amt,
    jcf.bic_zio_d5amt,
    jcf.bic_zio_d6amt,
    jcf.bic_zio_d7amt,
    jcf.cal_week,
    jcf.strnum,
    jcf.rep_mkt_code,
    jcf.rep_mkt_desc,
    jcf.emerg_mkt_ind,
    jcf.division_code,
    jcf.division_desc,
    jcf.area_code,
    jcf.area_desc,
    jcf.region_code,
    jcf.region_desc,
    jcf.district_code,
    jcf.district_desc,
    jcf.city,
    jcf.state,
    jcf.fs_open_dat,
    jcf.rx_open_dat,
    jcf.rx_division_code,
    jcf.rx_area_code,
    jcf.rx_region_code,
    jcf.rx_district_code,
    jcf.zrwstrtdate,
    jcf.zrwenddate,
    jcf.zweek,
    jcf.zmonth,
    jcf.zyear,
    jcf.comp_ver,
    jcf.fs_comp_wk,
    jcf.rx_comp_wk,
    pct.ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM
    Join_CompFlag jcf
    LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT pct
      ON  jcf.b631_s_proftctr = pct.prctr
      AND jcf.mandt            = pct.mandt
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 14: FLAGS
-- Logic: Computes the three calculated columns defined in
--        CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC:
--        (a) fs_rx_flag: 'FS' if LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1,2)='FS',
--            'RX' if LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1,2)='RX', else ''.
--            (HANA LEFTSTR mapped to BigQuery LEFT.)
--        (b) comp_flag: fs_comp_wk when fs_rx_flag='FS',
--            rx_comp_wk when fs_rx_flag='RX', else fs_comp_wk.
--        (c) cal_week_number: RIGHT(@ip_week_cy, 2) — last 2 chars
--            of the current-year week parameter.
--            (HANA RIGHTSTR mapped to BigQuery RIGHT.)
-- Source: Join_ProfitCenterText
-- Calculation: fs_rx_flag, comp_flag, cal_week_number
-- =====================================================================
FLAGS AS (
  SELECT
    fiscper,
    fiscvarnt,
    fiscyear,
    fiscper3,
    mandt,
    bic_zio_sweek,
    b631_s_chrtacct,
    b631_s_co_area,
    bic_zio_cmpcd,
    b631_s_proftctr,
    b631_s_costcntr,
    b631_s_funcarea,
    bic_zio_ver,
    bic_zio_saudt,
    b631_s_gl_acct,
    bic_zwwpc_pa1,
    bic_zwwsc_pa1,
    currency,
    b631_s_ledger,
    recordmode,
    b631_s_amount,
    bic_zio_d1amt,
    bic_zio_d2amt,
    bic_zio_d3amt,
    bic_zio_d4amt,
    bic_zio_d5amt,
    bic_zio_d6amt,
    bic_zio_d7amt,
    cal_week,
    strnum,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    city,
    state,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    zrwstrtdate,
    zrwenddate,
    zweek,
    zmonth,
    zyear,
    comp_ver,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    profit_center_text,
    CASE
      WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'FS' THEN 'FS'
      WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'RX' THEN 'RX'
      ELSE ''
    END AS fs_rx_flag,
    CASE
      WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'FS' THEN fs_comp_wk
      WHEN LEFT(bic_zwwpc_pa1, 2) = 'RX' THEN rx_comp_wk
      ELSE fs_comp_wk
    END AS comp_flag,
    RIGHT(@ip_week_cy, 2) AS cal_week_number
  FROM
    Join_ProfitCenterText
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT
-- Logic: Aggregates all rows from FLAGS CTE. Groups by all non-measure
--        columns. SUMs the financial measures. Applies the calculated
--        measure: b631_s_amount = SUM(b631_s_amount) * -1, as defined
--        in CV_COMP_FIN_ACTUAL_STATIC (_B631_S_AMOUNT_NEGATIVE * -1).
--        All output column names follow BigQuery style (lowercase,
--        no leading underscores) per Columns_Mapping BQ_COLUMN values.
-- Aggregation: SUM(b631_s_amount)*-1, SUM(bic_zio_d1amt..d7amt)
--              grouped by all non-measure columns
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  mandt,
  fiscper,
  fiscvarnt,
  fiscyear,
  fiscper3,
  bic_zio_sweek,
  b631_s_chrtacct,
  b631_s_co_area,
  bic_zio_cmpcd,
  b631_s_proftctr,
  fs_rx_flag,
  b631_s_costcntr,
  b631_s_funcarea,
  bic_zio_ver,
  bic_zio_saudt,
  b631_s_gl_acct,
  bic_zwwpc_pa1,
  bic_zwwsc_pa1,
  currency,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  comp_flag,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  city,
  state,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  cal_week_number,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  cal_week,
  strnum,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  SUM(b631_s_amount) * -1  AS b631_s_amount,
  SUM(bic_zio_d1amt)       AS bic_zio_d1amt,
  SUM(bic_zio_d2amt)       AS bic_zio_d2amt,
  SUM(bic_zio_d3amt)       AS bic_zio_d3amt,
  SUM(bic_zio_d4amt)       AS bic_zio_d4amt,
  SUM(bic_zio_d5amt)       AS bic_zio_d5amt,
  SUM(bic_zio_d6amt)       AS bic_zio_d6amt,
  SUM(bic_zio_d7amt)       AS bic_zio_d7amt
FROM
  FLAGS
GROUP BY
  mandt,
  fiscper,
  fiscvarnt,
  fiscyear,
  fiscper3,
  bic_zio_sweek,
  b631_s_chrtacct,
  b631_s_co_area,
  bic_zio_cmpcd,
  b631_s_proftctr,
  fs_rx_flag,
  b631_s_costcntr,
  b631_s_funcarea,
  bic_zio_ver,
  bic_zio_saudt,
  b631_s_gl_acct,
  bic_zwwpc_pa1,
  bic_zwwsc_pa1,
  currency,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  comp_flag,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  city,
  state,
  zrwstrtdate,
  zrwenddate,
  cal_week_number,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  cal_week,
  strnum,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code;
